title: Modular deck tiles with annotated product screenshots for partner enablement
creator: Maya Rodriguez
description: Create a set of modular slide tiles and supporting assets derived from live product screenshots for the Sales & Solutions quickstart deck. The goal is a reusable library of annotated, crop-optimized screenshots and composable layout tiles that sales engineers can combine into region-specific decks. Focus on clarity (annotated callouts), fidelity to product UI, and small file sizes for slide decks.
design_notes: Build three tile sizes: hero (16:9 background), mid (3:2 landscape), and compact (square) for feature highlight use-cases.
Use live console screenshots with subtle blur on customer data areas; include Figma masks for easy swaps.
Create 2 annotation styles: callout arrows with short copy (max 6 words) and numbered hotspots for step flows.
Provide light and dark theme variants; ensure accessibility contrast for annotations and labels.
Export optimized PNG and SVG overlays; supply source frames in Figma and a zipped assets package for Sales.
Avoid duplicating previous quickstart comps: emphasize modularity and rapid recombination rather than full-story slides.
tasks: Audit latest product screenshots from staging (console-2026.03) and flag any PII areas
Compose hero and mid tile templates in Figma with auto-layout and component variants
Design annotation glyph set and microcopy library for callouts
Generate export presets (PNG-72, PNG-150, SVG) and batch-export sample tiles
Prepare a one-page usage guide for Sales/SEs with drag-and-drop examples
Ship assets to Drive, update Sales enablement page, and run a short handoff session
screenshots_needed: Console home dashboard (token-level cost breakdown) - hero crop
Per-route latency trace view with highlighted error cluster - mid crop
Rollout canary config modal showing traffic split - compact crop
Model catalog quick view with performance badges - mid crop
KV cache metrics panel for cost-saving callout - hero crop
